create_binary_classification_output_laye: create a BinaryClassificationOutputLayer that computes predictions using argmax and logsigmoid scores from model logits
create_multiclass_output_layer: create a MulticlassOutputLayer that computes predictions using argmax and log_softmax scores from model logits
create_multilabel_output_layer: create a MultiLabelOutputLayer that computes binary predictions using logit threshold and logsigmoid scores
build_classification_scores_torchscript: build a TorchScript ClassificationScores module that maps class names to sigmoid or softmax scores from logits
export_classification_layer_to_caffe2: export a classification output layer to Caffe2 with Sigmoid or Softmax probability computation and blob generation
